description: This source file defines a Spring Boot web controller called HomeController. It provides an endpoint '/home' that forwards requests to the Swagger UI at '/bank-api/swagger-ui'. The class is part of the 'controller' package and facilitates navigation to Swagger documentation.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller that maps the '/home' URL to a forwarding method to facilitate access to Swagger UI.

methods.name: homeFallback
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/home' and forwards the request internally to the Swagger UI page.
